summary: Verified Apollo Builders enquiry form: backend wiring, spam protection (honeypot + timestamp gate), MongoDB persistence, professional email template with no third-party branding, no recipient email leaked to frontend, and full Contact form UI flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Email path is stubbed correctly — resend_client stays None while RESEND_API_KEY is empty; enquiries persist and email_sent=false as designed.
Honeypot spam returns 201 with a placeholder Enquiry but does NOT persist (verified via count check).
Timestamp gate (<3s) also silently rejected without persistence.

Recipient email (info@apollobuilders.com.au) is only in backend .env — no occurrence in frontend axios payload; frontend/src/lib/data.js contains it only as brand.email for public mailto display, which is acceptable per requirements.
Email HTML template scanned — no 'emergent', 'resend.com', 'development platform', 'lovable', or 'vercel' tokens found.
from_field uses `f"{SENDER_NAME} <{SENDER_EMAIL}>"` → resolves to 'Apollo Builders Website <onboarding@resend.dev>'.
Subject line format: 'New Website Enquiry — {project_type} — {name}' — clean, no branding.
seed_data_creation: Test enquiries prefixed TEST_ inserted during valid-path tests; safe to purge if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once RESEND_API_KEY is populated and domain is verified, re-run test_health_email_pending expecting 'configured', and manually verify one real email dispatch. Currently email path is intentionally stubbed.
